items.title: O Allah, Give First to the Mountains and Stones
items.moral: Moral: True generosity means thinking of others before oneself. This prayer carries within it an entire people’s tradition of sharing.
body: An old prayer from the Turkic lands says:
“O Allah, give first to the mountains and stones, the forests, the animals, and the waters. Then give to the people, to my neighbor, and to those in need. If anything remains, give to me last.”

items.title: The Strength of Truth
items.moral: Moral: Truth is unbending and unyielding. Even though time passes and power changes, in the end, the righteous one stands firm.
body: Truth’s sword does not bend, and the hand that holds it does not yield.

items.title: The Rose
items.moral: Moral: Love and care need balance. Too much control can harm, just as neglect can; attentive care helps life flourish.
body: If you water a rose too much, it will rot; if you water it too little, it will wither; if you water it right, it will live.
